input: Set up a carpool schedule with school parents

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing whether this covers drop-offs, pickups, or both — and whether it includes special days like after-school activities — determines how complex the schedule needs to be.
The number of parents and children involved directly affects how driving duties are divided and rotated.
The days of the week and times the carpool runs define the entire structure of the rotation.
Some parents may have hard limits — certain days they cannot drive, car seat requirements, or vehicle capacity — which constrain how the schedule can be built.
Whether the schedule will be shared via a group chat, a spreadsheet, an app, or printed paper changes how it should be formatted and maintained.
The rotation style — strict weekly turns vs. a flexible swap-based system — affects how fair and easy the schedule is to follow long-term.
Understanding whether the goal is just an initial draft to propose to parents, or a fully agreed-upon and running schedule, sets the right finish line for this task.

gold.taskTitle: Set up a carpool schedule with school parents
gold.taskDescription: Create and coordinate a recurring carpool schedule among a group of parents for school drop-offs and/or pickups.

questions.title: Does this cover drop-offs, pickups, or both?
questions.description: Clarify which direction(s) of the school commute the carpool schedule needs to account for.

questions.title: How many parents and children are in the group?
questions.description: Determine the total number of participating families to structure driving rotations fairly.

questions.title: Which days and times does the carpool need to run?
questions.description: Identify the specific school days and relevant times to build the recurring schedule around.

questions.title: Do any parents have days they absolutely cannot drive?
questions.description: Surface hard constraints per parent — unavailable days, car capacity limits, or other restrictions — that the schedule must respect.

questions.title: Where will the final schedule be shared with the group?
questions.description: Decide on the tool or format — group chat, shared spreadsheet, app, or printed sheet — used to distribute and update the schedule.

questions.title: Should driving turns rotate on a fixed or flexible basis?
questions.description: Establish whether parents follow a strict pre-assigned rotation or a more flexible swap-friendly arrangement.

questions.title: Is the goal a draft proposal or a fully agreed schedule?
questions.description: Define what 'done' looks like — whether you need just a starting draft to circulate, or a confirmed schedule all parents have signed off on.
